title: The 'Wisdom Milestone' card states a fabricated insight about the user's reading
detail: `stats.finished.length > 5 ? ' Your focus is shifting towards more productivity-centric topics recently.'` is a hardcoded sentence with no connection to the user's actual categories. Anyone who has read six horror novels is told their focus is shifting toward productivity. The 'Continuous Learner' badge below it is likewise unconditional. A dashboard that invents observations is worse than one that omits them.

title: The interactive stat cards are divs, so the dashboard filters are mouse-only
detail: StatCard renders <div onClick> with no role, tabIndex or key handler. Two of the four cards are the page's only filtering control, and neither can be reached or activated from the keyboard.

title: Total Learning reads 0m for any imported library
detail: totalTime sums readingTimeMinutes, which importGoodreadsRows sets to 0 for every row. A 300-book import therefore reports zero learning time, and the milestone card renders 'enough knowledge to discuss deep concepts for over 0 hours straight'.

title: Average rating counts unrated books as zero
detail: The mean is taken over every Finished book including those with rating 0, so importing finished-but-unrated books drives the headline average toward 0.0 rather than excluding them.

title: avgRating returns a string or a number depending on the branch
detail: toFixed(1) yields '4.0' while the empty case yields the number 0, so the card renders '0' where it otherwise renders '0.0'.
